```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggtext)
library(here)
library(fontawesome)
library(showtext)

if (interactive()) {
  params <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(
    rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path
  )$params
}

dashboard <- read_csv(here("data/solano_dashboard.csv")) |>
  filter(
    rtype == "D" &
      districtname == params$lea |
      charter_flag == "Y" & rtype == "S" & schoolname == params$lea
  ) |>
  mutate(
    statuslevel = as_factor(statuslevel),
    # reportingyear = fct_relevel(as_factor(reportingyear), "2019"),
    studentgroup = as_factor(studentgroup),
    student_group_long = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(student_group_long),
      "All students",
      "American Indian or Alaska Native",
      "Asian",
      "Black/African American",
      "Filipino",
      "Hispanic",
      "Pacific Islander",
      "White",
      "Multiple Races/Two or more",
      "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged",
      "Homeless Youth",
      "Students with Disabilities",
      "Foster Youth",
      "English Learner",
      "Long-Term English Learner",
      "English Learners Only",
      "RFEPs Only",
      "English Only",
      "Smarter Balanced Assessment",
      "CA Alternative Assessment"
    ),
    charter_flag = if_else(is.na(charter_flag), "N", charter_flag),
    color = as_factor(color),
    indicator = case_match(
      indicator,
      "ELA" ~ "ELA (DFS)",
      "Math" ~ "Math (DFS)",
      "science" ~ "Science",
      "college/career" ~ "College/\nCareer",
      .default = indicator
    ),
    indicator = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(indicator),
      "ELA (DFS)",
      "Math (DFS)",
      "ELPI",
      "absenteeism",
      "graduation",
      "suspension",
      "College/\nCareer",
      "Science"
    ),
    lea = if_else(charter_flag == "Y", schoolname, districtname)
  ) |>
  select(
    reportingyear,
    districtname,
    schoolname,
    student_group_long,
    indicator,
    currnumer,
    currdenom,
    currstatus,
    color,
    change,
    changelevel,
    priority_eligible,
    indicator_eligible,
    charter_flag,
    curr_prep
  )

is_charter <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(districtname == params$lea | schoolname == params$lea) |>
  pull(charter_flag) |>
  nth(1)

status_colors <- c(
  "lightgrey",
  "tomato",
  "orange",
  "yellow",
  "mediumseagreen",
  "dodgerblue",
  "darkgrey"
)

indicator_colors = c(
  "ELA (DFS)" = "#CC6677",
  "Math (DFS)" = "#882255",
  "ELPI" = "#AA4499",
  "College/\nCareer" = "#332288",
  "graduation" = "#88CCEE",
  "absenteeism" = "#44AA99",
  "suspension" = "#117733",
  "Science" = "#DDCC77"
)

da_groups <-
  dashboard |>
  mutate(reportingyear = as_factor(reportingyear)) |>
  filter(
    reportingyear %in% c(2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2019, 2018, 2017),
    indicator_eligible == TRUE
  ) |>
  select(-indicator_eligible)

wide_da_groups <-
  da_groups |>
  select(
    reportingyear,
    districtname,
    schoolname,
    student_group_long,
    indicator
  ) |>
  arrange(reportingyear) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = reportingyear,
    values_from = indicator,
    values_fn = list
  ) |>
  arrange(districtname, schoolname, student_group_long)

clean_groups <-
  wide_da_groups |>
  mutate(
    across(where(is.list), ~ map_chr(., ~ paste(., collapse = "; "))),
    da_years = rowSums(across(matches("^\\d{4}$"), ~ . != ""))
  ) |>
  filter(da_years >= 3) |>
  mutate(`2019` = if ("2019" %in% names(wide_da_groups)) `2019` else "") |>
  select(districtname, student_group_long, `2022`, `2023`, `2024`, `2025`)

font_add('fa-solid', here('fonts/fa-solid-900.ttf'))
```

## `r paste0(params$lea, if_else(is_charter == "N"," School District", ""))` `r params$year` Dashboard Overview and DA Eligibility

```{r dashboard-plot}
#| echo: FALSE
#| fig.width: 9.6
#| fig.height: 4.8
#| fig-column: page

showtext_auto()

# element_markdown uses <br> for newlines
html_wrap <- function(s, width = 17) {
  str_wrap(s, width = width) |>
    str_replace_all("\n", "<br>")
}

dashboard_filtered <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(
    reportingyear == params$year,
    student_group_long %in%
      c(
        "All students",
        "American Indian or Alaska Native",
        "Asian",
        "Black/African American",
        "Filipino",
        "Hispanic",
        "Pacific Islander",
        "White",
        "Multiple Races/Two or more",
        "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged",
        "Homeless Youth",
        "Students with Disabilities",
        "Foster Youth",
        "English Learner",
        "Long-Term English Learner"
      )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    student_group_wrapped = str_wrap(student_group_long, width = 17),
    change = if_else(is.na(change), "", paste(change)),
    change_arrow = if_else(
      indicator %in%
        c(
          "ELA (DFS)",
          "Math (DFS)",
          "ELPI",
          "graduation",
          "College/\nCareer",
          "Science"
        ),
      case_match(
        changelevel,
        0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
        1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
        2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
        3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
        4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
        5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
        .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"
      ),
      case_match(
        changelevel,
        0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
        5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
        4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
        3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
        2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
        1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
        .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(student_group_long)

group_count <-
  dashboard_filtered |>
  select(student_group_long) |>
  unique() |>
  nrow()

da_eligible <-
  dashboard_filtered |>
  group_by(student_group_long) |>
  arrange(student_group_long) |>
  summarise(group_da_eligible = sum(priority_eligible)) |>
  mutate(
    order = c(1:group_count),
    student_group_markdown = if_else(
      group_da_eligible > 0,
      paste(
        "<span style='color: darkred;face: bold'>", # Group is eligible
        html_wrap(student_group_long, width = 17),
        "</span>"
      ),
      paste(
        "<span style='color: black'>", # group is not eligible
        html_wrap(student_group_long, width = 17),
        "</span>"
      )
    ),
    student_group_markdown = fct_reorder(student_group_markdown, order)
  )

dashboard_filtered |>
  left_join(da_eligible, by = join_by(student_group_long)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_richtext(
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    mapping = aes(
      label = if_else(
        indicator == "ELA (DFS)" |
          indicator == "Math (DFS)" |
          indicator == "Science" |
          is.na(currstatus),
        paste(currstatus, change_arrow, change),
        paste0(currstatus, "% ", change_arrow, " ", change)
      ),
      fill = color,
      color = indicator_eligible
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    text.color = "black",
    label.size = 0.8,
    size = 3.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE, na.value = "white") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = NA, "TRUE" = "darkred"),
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    student_group_markdown ~ indicator,
    scales = "free",
    space = "free"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text.y = element_markdown(
      size = 11,
      angle = 0,
      vjust = 0.7,
      hjust = 0
    ),
    strip.clip = "off",
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt")
  )

showtext_auto(FALSE)
```

## DA Eligible Groups

`r if_else(is_charter == "N", "For 2025-2026, districts become eligible for DA based on:", "For 2025-2026, the DA eligibility criteria for charter schools is the same as for districts and COEs except charter schools have to meet the criteria based on any of the methods across two years. Those methods are:")`

-   Student group performance in two or more Local Control Funding Formula (LCFF) state priority areas, or
-   Performance on local indicators in two or more priority areas, or
-   A combination of student group performance in one state priority area and local indicator performance in one different priority area.

Results from the 2024 and 2025 Dashboards are used in differentiated assistance determinations. Table 1 provides a summary of the student groups eligible for DA in `r paste0(params$lea, if(is_charter == "N") " School District")` for `r paste0(params$year, "-", parse_number(params$year) + 1)`.

```{r}
#| label: dashboard-eligible
#| echo: FALSE
#| tbl-cap: "Student groups eligible for DA"
#| cap-location: bottom

eligible_indicators <-
  dashboard_filtered |>
  filter(indicator_eligible == TRUE) |>
  pull(indicator) |>
  unique()

dashboard_filtered |>
  filter(
    indicator_eligible == TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    currstatus = if_else(
      indicator %in% c("ELA (DFS)", "Math (DFS)", "Science"),
      paste0(currstatus),
      paste0(currstatus, "%")
    ),
    # n_count = case_when(indicator == "ELA (DFS)" |
    #                    indicator == "Math (DFS)" |
    #                    indicator == "Science" ~ currdenom,
    #                    .default = currnumer),
    currnumer_str = case_when(
      indicator == "ELA (DFS)" |
        indicator == "Math (DFS)" |
        indicator == "Science" ~ "*",
      indicator == "College/\nCareer" ~ as.character(curr_prep),
      .default = as.character(currnumer)
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    student_group_long,
    indicator,
    currnumer_str,
    currdenom,
    currstatus,
    change
  ) |>
  arrange(student_group_long) |>
  flextable() |>
  line_spacing(space = 0.2, part = "body") |>
  set_header_labels(
    student_group_long = "Student Group",
    indicator = "Indicator",
    # n_count = "N count",
    currnumer_str = "Numerator",
    currdenom = "Denominator",
    currstatus = "Current Status",
    change = "Change"
  ) |>
  theme_vanilla() |>
  merge_v(j = "student_group_long") |>
  width(width = c(1.8, 1, 0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 0.6)) |>
  align(
    align = c("left", "left", "right", "right", "right", "right"),
    part = "all"
  )

```

# `r params$lea` Intensive Assistance

The results of the 2025 California School Dashboard indicate that `r initials` is eligible for Intensive Differentiated Assistance based on the performance of student groups on the Dashboard. Education Code 52072 states that the Solano County Office of Education shall provide intensive assistance when three or more pupil student groups meet the criteria for three or more consecutive years. The California Collaborative for Educational Excellence (CCEE) with the county superintendent of schools shall provide technical assistance to the school district. Using the eligibility criteria, `r initials` qualifies for Intensive Assistance as three or more student groups (`r student_group_count` in this case) have been eligible for DA for at least three out of four consecutive years. Eligible indicators are listed for the previous four years used in qualifying each student group: 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025. The criteria being met by the student group(s) each year may not have been identical from year to year.

```{r da_groups}
#| echo: false

names_groups <- names(clean_groups)

clean_groups |>
  select(-districtname) |>
  flextable() |>
  set_header_labels(values = list("student_group_long" = "Student Group")) |>
  width(width = 1.3) |>
  add_header_row(
    values = c("Student Group", "DA Eligible Indicators"),
    colwidths = c(1, ncol(clean_groups) - 2)
  ) |>
  merge_v(part = "header", j = 1) |>
  theme_vanilla() |>
  align(align = "center", part = "header") |>
  align(align = "left", part = "header", j = 1) |>
  set_caption(paste(
    params$lea,
    "student groups eligible for DA three of the last four years."
  ))


```

## Indicator Trends for Student Groups Eligible for Intensive Assistance

```{r student_groups}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
#| fig-column: screen

wrap_length <- 20

for (group in student_groups_list) {
  academic <-
    dashboard |>
    filter(student_group_long == group) |>
    filter(indicator %in% c("ELA (DFS)", "Math (DFS)"))

  min_year <- min(academic$reportingyear)
  max_year <- max(academic$reportingyear)

  academic_graph <-
    academic |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x = reportingyear,
      y = currstatus,
      group = indicator,
      color = indicator
    )) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = currstatus, color = indicator),
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = indicator_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min_year, max_year, by = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Status of **academic indicators** over time for<br>the **",
        group,
        "** student group in ",
        params$lea
      ),
      x = "Year",
      y = "Status (Distance from Standard)",
      color = "Indicator",
      caption = "Colors not reflective of assigned Dashboard colors."
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, linewidth = wrap_length))

  print(academic_graph)
  cat("\n\n\n")

  if (group %in% c("English Learner", "Long-Term English Learner")) {
    elpi <-
      dashboard |>
      filter(student_group_long == group) |>
      filter(indicator == "ELPI")

    min_year <- min(elpi$reportingyear)
    max_year <- max(elpi$reportingyear)

    elpi_graph <-
      elpi |>
      ggplot(aes(
        x = reportingyear,
        y = currstatus,
        group = indicator,
        color = indicator
      )) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
      geom_point(size = 2.2) +
      geom_text_repel(
        aes(label = currstatus, color = indicator),
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = indicator_colors) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min_year, max_year, by = 1)) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          "Status of ELPI over time for<br>the **",
          group,
          "** student group in ",
          params$lea
        ),
        x = "Year",
        y = "Status (Percent making progress)",
        color = "Indicator",
        caption = "Colors not reflective of assigned Dashboard colors."
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, linewidth = wrap_length))

    print(elpi_graph)
    cat("\n\n\n")
  }

  nonacademic <-
    dashboard |>
    filter(student_group_long == group) |>
    filter(
      indicator %in%
        c("absenteeism", "graduation", "suspension", "college/career")
    )

  min_year <- min(nonacademic$reportingyear)
  max_year <- max(nonacademic$reportingyear)

  nonacademic_graph <-
    nonacademic |>
    ggplot(aes(
      x = reportingyear,
      y = currstatus / 100,
      group = indicator,
      color = indicator
    )) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = paste0(currstatus, "%"), color = indicator),
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min_year, max_year, by = 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = indicator_colors) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Status of **non-academic indicators** over time for<br>the **",
        group,
        "** student group in ",
        params$lea
      ),
      x = "Year",
      y = "Status (Percent)",
      color = "Indicator",
      caption = "CCI only reported for 2019, 2023, 2024, and 2025, where applicable."
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, linewidth = wrap_length))

  print(nonacademic_graph)
  cat("\\newpage\n\n")
}

```
